questions.question: how do i do pushups
questions.exampleAnswer:
Pushups
1. Start in a high plank, with hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
2. Lower your chest by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
3. Push back up. Use your knees for a gentler variation.
Stop if it feels painful or unsuitable.

questions.question: teach me squats

Squats
1. Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart.
2. Bend at your hips and knees, keeping your chest comfortably lifted.
3. Press through your feet to return to standing.
Stop if it feels painful or unsuitable.

questions.question: how to perform a plank
questions.exampleAnswer:
Plank
1. Place your forearms on the floor, with elbows under your shoulders.
2. Extend your legs and keep your body in a straight line.
3. Breathe steadily. Lower your knees whenever you need a break.
Stop if it feels painful or unsuitable.

questions.question: how about lunges

2. Bend both knees within a comfortable range, keeping your torso upright.
3. Return to standing, then alternate sides. Each side counts as one rep.
